items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: And Justin was born in Bay St. Louis.

ctx.x: And my brother also was born there. Then I had a sister, one of my sisters, she was born on Rayshelheim Street. And my other sister, the one that's living here on O'Reilly Street. Well, she was born on Rayshelheim Street. And Justin was born in Bay St. Louis.
Do you know if your father and uncle ever went back to Mexico to visit any relatives? Did you ever hear them say if they were going back to visit anyone? Well, I want to be frank with you.
